Parses the output URI "-". This allocates an xmlURIPtr on the heap.

When xmlAllocOutputBufferInternal returns NULL, the encoder is freed via xmlCharEncCloseFunc. The handler is now dangling.

Since buf is NULL, htmlSaveFileFormat calls xmlCharEncCloseFunc(handler) on the already-freed handler. This is the heap-use-after-free: the handler pointer was freed in step 20, and now xmlCharEncCloseFunc dereferences freed memory.

code: xmlFree(handler->name); if (handler->ctxtDtor != NULL) { handler->ctxtDtor(handler->inputCtxt); handler->ctxtDtor(handler->outputCtxt); } xmlFree(handler);
note: Second call on the freed handler. Reads handler->name and handler->ctxtDtor from freed heap memory, causing a heap-use-after-free read. If the freed memory has been reused, this leads to arbitrary code execution or crash.
